name: Blockyard Fabric
author: operator@blockyard.local
description: Reviewed Minecraft 1.21.1 installer. EULA acceptance is required separately. Loader variables are operator-managed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
rm -f .blockyard-install.json
curl --user-agent "Blockyard/0.1 (Minecraft hosting)" --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 600 --fail --location --retry 3 "https://maven.fabricmc.net/net/fabricmc/fabric-installer/${FABRIC_VERSION}/fabric-installer-${FABRIC_VERSION}.jar" -o installer.jar
java -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0 -jar installer.jar server -mcversion "$MC_VERSION" -loader "$LOADER_VERSION" -downloadMinecraft
mv server.jar minecraft-server.jar
mv fabric-server-launch.jar server.jar
printf 'serverJar=minecraft-server.jar\n' > fabric-server-launcher.properties
rm installer.jar
jar tf server.jar > /dev/null
printf '{"software":"FABRIC","minecraft_version":"%s","loader_version":"%s"}\n' "${MC_VERSION}" "${LOADER_VERSION}" > .blockyard-install.json.tmp
mv .blockyard-install.json.tmp .blockyard-install.json

# First-install access defaults; preserve settings on reinstall.
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  printf 'online-mode=false\nwhite-list=false\n' > server.properties
fi
